evidence: python - has used 98% of a core for over 60 minutes
it keeps writing to the tool pipe but the call can not finish
result.diagnosis: A stray `python -` REPL spins at full CPU and will never return the call.
result.mechanism: `python -` was started with no script, so it opened a REPL on the tool pipe that spins and never exits
result.avoid: Pass the script file or use python -c with the code; never start a bare python - REPL
